executiveSummary: AI safety and trust are major concerns as tech companies develop and deploy new AI-powered products. Meanwhile, supply chain issues and hardware releases dominate the headlines. Pricing changes and new product announcements add to the mix.

takeaways.title: AI safety and trust
takeaways.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei emphasizes the need for trust in AI, while a woman claims AI tools are being used to create explicit imagery. ChatGPT's Computer History tracks user clicks and keystrokes, raising concerns about data privacy.

takeaways.title: Supply chain issues
takeaways.description: Apple is expanding its Certified Refurbished Store with new MacBook Air and iPhone 16 Plus configurations, amid supply chain issues. The company is also exploring alternatives to alleviate the shortage.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple is preparing to release iOS 27 and new iPhone models, with a focus on smart home products. The company is also expanding its Certified Refurbished Store with new products.

worthWatching: The impact of AI on society and trust
The growing concern over AI-powered tools and their potential misuse
engineeringPerspective: The technical challenge of implementing AI-powered features without compromising user privacy
The importance of developing robust and secure AI systems that prioritize user trust
